name: photo-revival
title_zh: 把随手拍变成手绘诗意插画
tagline_zh: 照片滤镜看腻了？想要留白、色块和手写小字，而不是磨皮和锐化。它把日常瞬间重画成纸上作品，像寄出的明信片。
tagline_en: Tired of filters that just beautify? Turn snapshots into hand-drawn illustrations with white space, vivid color.
desc_en: Turn ordinary photos or everyday snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations with large white-paper negative space, vivid localized color, subtle collage accents, and tiny handwritten captions. Use when a user wants a real photo reimagined as an illustration rather than filtered, beautified, or photorealistically edited.
why_zh: 不是风格迁移，而是重构画面：先抽结构再上色，留白和拼贴是主动设计，手写小字给照片加了一层叙事时间。
why_en: Not style transfer—it rebuilds the image: extracts structure, then applies color with deliberate negative space and collage.
limit_zh: 只处理单张静物/人像/街拍，不接多图合成或文字密集的截图；输出为扁平插画风，不保留原图光影细节；需要网络调用模型。
limit_en: Single stills/portraits/street shots only; no multi-image composites or text-heavy screenshots. Output is flat illustration—no original lighting.
